adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts` the diff adds an unconditional refresh-token HTTP request before constructing/returning the `jsforce.Connection` (the `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` block runs every time this code path executes). This adds avoidable latency and introduces a new hard failure path on every connection creation. The success check is also brittle: `if (response.statusText !== "OK") throw new HttpError(...)` relies on `statusText` instead of `response.ok`/`response.status`, so a non-"OK"/empty statusText will raise `HttpError 400` even if the numeric status could be successful or the message is missing, which is a correctness defect introduced by the change.
